item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app available to all
item.description:
The GitHub Copilot app is now available on all Copilot plans. Users can sign in with a GitHub account and use it for agent-driven development from desktop on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: dotnet: Packaging and Package Identity for .NET apps with WinApp CLI on Windows
item.description:
Microsoft describes using the WinApp CLI to add package identity and create packages for .NET desktop apps on Windows. This enables deeper Windows integration and simpler distribution.

  • Source: .NET
